=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes

• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• IBPS PO Mains Result 2026: आईबीपीएस पीओ मेन्स रिजल्ट ibps.in जल्द, स्कोरकार्ड डायरेक्ट लिंक से चेक करें : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Result for the Post of Project Nurse : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Online / Written Computer Based Test (Domain Technical + Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Trade Test / Skill & Practical Test (Qualifying in Nature)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• SBI Clerk prelims result 2026 for junior associate out : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI Clerk 2026 Prelims Result : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI Clerk Score Card 2026 Out, Check Prelims Marks, Direct Link and Cut Off : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• VSSC  Advertisement No: VSSC 334 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result 2026 Out, Graduate Merit List PDF Zone Wise, Scorecard Link : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• IBPS PO Result 2025 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI Clerk prelims result 2026 expected to be released soon: Check how to download scorecards : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 कब आएगा? 🔥 Big Update : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)

• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. • RRB GROUP D 2025 RESULT OUT : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UIIC AO Prelims Result 2026 Out, Download Result PDF at uiic.co.in : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• 0110 : Instrumentation Engineering (Under Process)
• 0111 : Instrumentation and Electronics Engineering (Under Process)
• 0114 : Mechanical Engineering (Under Process)
• 0115 : Metallurgical Engineering (Under Process)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Next Stage Trade Test (Technician-A) and Document Verification (STA-B)
• Tier 1 Result 25 May 2026
• Tier 2 CBT 15 June 2026
• Shortlisted candidates must appear for the Trade Test in their trade. The schedule is Not Yet Announced.
• Whether any candidates are exempt from the Trade Test is Not Available Officially in the result notice. Read the recruitment advertisement for exemption rules.
• Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification . The schedule is Not Yet Announced.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• RRB Group d Result 2025 Out🔥 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===

• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System

• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CPO Paper 1 Admit Card 2026: एसएससी सीपीओ पेपर 1 एडमिट कार्ड जारी, हॉल टिकट डाउनलोड करें : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC GD Syllabus 2027 (Updated): Download Subject Wise Exam Pattern PDF and Marking Scheme : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• SSC JE answer key 2026 released, check steps to download and deadline : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined

• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===

• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)

General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam City Slip 2025 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• TOSS SSC, Intermediate October 2026 Results Out: Check Direct Link and Download Marks Memo : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UKSSSC Constable Syllabus 2026: Check Exam Pattern and Subject : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• RRB Paramedical Staff : 365
• Dialysis Technician : 01
• Health & Malaria Inspector Gr II : 43
• Audiologist & Speech Therapist : 01
• Pharmacist (Entry Grade) : 118
• Radiographer X-Ray Technician : 25

• Pharmacist (Entry Grade) : Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy (Allopathic) from a Central or State Government recognized University or Institute and registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948 OR Doctor of Pharmacy from a Central or State Government recognized University or Institute and registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948 Age Limit : 20-35 Years
• Radiographer (X-Ray Technician) : Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics and Chemistry and possess a 2-year Diploma in Radiography, X-Ray Technician, or Radiodiagnosis Technology from a recognized institute. Science graduates with the above 2-year Diploma will be preferred. Equivalent/acceptable qualifications include B.Sc. Medical Technology in Radiography, B.Sc. Medical Radiography and Imaging Technology, B.Sc. (Radiography), B.Sc. Medical Imaging Technology, B.Sc. Radiological & Image Techniques, 2-year Diploma in Radiation Technology, or 10+2 with Physics and Chemistry along with a Bachelor’s degree in Radiation Technology. Age Limit : 19-33 Years
• Health & Malaria Inspector Grade-II : Candidates must have a B.Sc. degree with Chemistry as a main or optional subject and must possess either a 1-year Diploma in Health/Sanitary Inspector or a 1-year National Trade Certificate (NTC) in Health Sanitary Inspector awarded by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT), Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. Age Limit : 18-33 Years
• Lab Assistant Grade-II : Candidates must have passed 12th (10+2) in Science and possess either a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) or a Certificate Course in Medical Laboratory Technology equivalent to DMLT. The course must be from a recognized institution, of at least 1 year duration, completed on a full-time basis, with a prescribed examination successfully passed. B.Sc. in Medical Lab Technology after 10+2 Science is also an equivalent/acceptable qualification. Approved qualifications obtained through recognized Open and Distance Learning (ODL) institutions are also acceptable. Age Limit : 18-33 Years
• Dialysis Technician : B.Sc. plus (a) Diploma in Haemodialysis (or) (b) two years satisfactory in-house Training / Experience in Haemodialysis work in a reputed institution (proof to be attached). NOTE: B.Sc. in Dialysis Techniques/ B.Sc. in Dialysis Technology/ B.Sc. in Renal Dialysis Technology are also equivalent/acceptable qualifications. Age Limit : 20-33 Years
• OPTOMETRIST : B. Sc. In Optometry or Diploma in Ophthalmic Technician (the course should be of 3 to 4 years duration). The candidate should have Registration with the concerned Council/ Licensing body. Age Limit : 18-33 Years
• ECG Technician : Candidates must have passed 10+2 or Graduation in Science and possess a Certificate, Diploma, or Degree in ECG Laboratory Technology, Cardiology, Cardiology Technician, or Cardiology Techniques from a reputed institution. The Certificate must be of at least 1 year duration. Qualifications obtained through approved Open and Distance Learning (ODL) mode from UGC-recognized institutions are also acceptable for Central Government employment. Age Limit : 18-33 Years

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• CBT Exam Document Verification Medical Examination
• Document Verification
• Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• BSF Tradesman Admit Card 2026 OUT: बीएसएफ ट्रेड्समैन एडमिट कार्ड rectt.bsf.gov.in पर जारी, यहां एक क्लिक से डाउनलोड करें हॉल टिकट : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• OPSC APP admit card 2026 out: Assistant Public Prosecutor exam on November 22, download hall tickets here : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level : General (EWS)
• 1280 : 280 (773)
• Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk : 10+2 Intermediate Exam From Any Recognized Board in India. General / OBC / EWS : 50% Marks. SC / ST / PH : Pass Only
• Accounts Clerk Cum Typist : 10+2 Intermediate Exam From Any Recognized Board in India. General / OBC / EWS : 50% Marks. SC / ST / PH : Pass Only. Computer Typing English 30 WPM OR Hindi 25 WPM

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• CBT-II Exam Date : 17 September 2026
• CBT-II Admit Card : 13 September 2026
• CBT-II Answer Key : 24 September 2026
• CBT-II Result : 30 October 2026
• CBTST Date : 27 November 2026 Tentative
• Check & Download CBT-II Zone Wise Result / Cutoff

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.
